pages.text: A Sorting Machine separates items by an item tag. Rename a vanilla Name Tag in an anvil to a tag ID, such as $(thing)forge:ores$(). Put that Name Tag into the filter slot. Then feed items into the main inventory.

pages.name: Two Output Chests
pages.text: Stand in front of the sorter. Matching items go to your right. Other items go left.

pages.title: Keep Both Outputs Open
pages.text: The sorter waits for a valid filter and keeps items when the appropriate receiver will not accept them. Match and non-match chests are separate. It routes without Forge Energy.$(br2)Speed upgrades shorten the delay between transfers.
